Name: AcidHeartmus's Rose Cows for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from AcidHeartmus, I've converted their BFAV Rose Cows (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8084) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to AcidHeartmus for the original mod. 

Rose Cows live in Barns and produce rose milk, which can be turned into meringue with a cheese press.

Enjoy!
